mentions.name: Breadboard helpers (Circuit Pixies)
mentions.description: This project makes small breadboard helper modules for electronics prototyping and learning; currently one module covers Resistor Transistor Logic (RTL), with the design shared on the Circuit Pixies site.
mentions.source_excerpt: As I explore and learn I've begun to make these small "breadboard helpers" [1]. (Just one on Resistor Transistor Logic (RTL) right now.)
